metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2026 · Passenger
metas.description: After a young couple witnesses a gruesome highway accident, they soon realize they did not leave the crash scene alone, as a demonic presence called the Passenger won't stop until it claims them both.

metas.name: ★ 4.2 · 2026 · Just Play Dead
metas.description: A criminal plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmaneuver each other in a deadly battle of wits.

metas.name: 2026 · Clayface
metas.description: Rising Hollywood star Matt Hagen descends into a horrifying revenge-filled monster when scientific ambition strips him of his identity and humanity.

metas.name: ★ 5.2 · 2026 · It's A Medical Miracle
metas.description: A young man declared brain-dead suddenly awakens with the ability to hear everything. Seeking the nurse whose voice saved him, he's drawn into a dark game of masks, memories, and revenge where every sound may be a clue or a trap.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2025 · Gondhal
metas.description: Suman, a newly-wedded wife in Maharashtra's Gondhal rituals, conspires with Gondhali Saheba to kill her husband, Anand. They plan to carry out an escape that jeopardises her soul amid drum-driven ritual and divine omens, blurring the distinction between salvation and damnation in a citywide verdict of fire, blood, and awe.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Fjord
metas.description: An immigrant Romanian family living in Norway is subject to an investigation and faces the scrutiny of the local judicial system.
